seo_title: Find USA Scholarships Open to Non US Citizens
seo_description: Scholarships open to non US citizens in the USA with deadlines, award details, and eligibility notes. Compare listings and apply on official pages.
intro: Trying to find USA scholarships you can actually apply for as a non-US citizen usually means sorting past listings with mixed eligibility language. This filtered view brings together a focused set of programs tied to that need, including opportunities connected to education, STEM, community, medicine, arts, and other areas. You can compare options for different study levels, from high school seniors through college and graduate students, while checking how each listing handles citizenship or residency details. Awards vary widely by program, and deadlines differ by row, so it is worth reviewing each entry closely rather than assuming one pattern fits all. Some listings may have lighter application requirements, while others ask for essays or more documentation, so use the details in each row before you apply.
h1: Find Scholarships Open to Non US Citizens USA
supporting: A useful way to browse this list is to compare three things side by side: eligibility wording, study level, and field of study. In this USA scholarship slice, you may see listings tied to education, engineering, business, English, health professions, and broader miscellaneous categories. Some titles are clearly aimed at international students, while others may include non-US citizens alongside other residency groups, so read the requirement lines carefully. If an amount is shown, treat it as listing-specific and verify it on the official page before making decisions. Because some deadlines appear relatively soon, it makes sense to shortlist promising rows early and check dates promptly.
related_intro: If you do not find the right fit here, compare nearby scholarship pages by study level, subject area, or requirement type. That can help you separate broad international-student options from programs that are more specific to majors, essay expectations, or academic stage in the USA.

faq.question: How can I find scholarships in the USA that are open to non-US citizens?
faq.answer: Use this filtered view to explore listings tagged for non-US citizens, then compare each row’s eligibility details on the official source. In this USA-focused catalog, citizenship, residency, study level, and field can vary by program.

faq.question: Can I apply to every scholarship listed here if I am an international student?
faq.answer: Not automatically. This page helps you find programs that may be open to non-US citizens, but you should verify the exact eligibility rules on each official scholarship page before you apply.

faq.question: What should I compare before I apply?
faq.answer: Compare eligibility, study level, field of study, deadline text, and application requirements row by row. Award amounts also vary by listing, so confirm the current amount and terms on the official page.

faq.question: Do all of these scholarships have the same deadline or essay requirement?
faq.answer: No—deadlines differ by program, and some dates may be coming up soon, so check each listing promptly. Essay requirements are mixed across these rows, so review the requirements on the official source before you apply.
